policies.title: Congolese citizens: constitutional right of return
policies.summary: A Congolese national's ordinary-passport diagonal is citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa route.
conditions: Applies to a Congolese citizen using a standard Congolese ordinary passport; lawful document, identity, health, security and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Ivorian citizens: constitutional right of return
policies.summary: An Ivorian citizen's ordinary-passport diagonal is citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa route.
conditions: Applies to an Ivorian citizen using a standard Ivorian ordinary passport; lawful document, identity, health, security and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Eswatini citizens: constitutional right of entry
policies.summary: An Eswatini citizen's ordinary-passport diagonal is citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa route.
conditions: Applies to an Eswatini citizen using a standard ordinary passport; lawful document, identity, health, security and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Mauritian citizens: statutory admission
policies.summary: The Immigration Act makes citizenship an independent basis for admission; the visa limb concerns non-citizens.
conditions: Applies to a Mauritian citizen using a standard ordinary passport; lawful document, identity, health, security and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Nigerian ordinary passport holder: citizenship
policies.summary: The Immigration Act confines Nigerian passports to bona fide Nigerians.
conditions: Full valid ordinary Nigerian passport only; ordinary border controls and statutory passport restrictions remain applicable.

policies.title: Rwandan national: right of return
policies.summary: The Constitution directly guarantees every Rwandan the right to return to Rwanda.
conditions: Applies to a Rwandan citizen using a standard ordinary passport; lawful public-order, security, document and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: South African national passport entry
policies.summary: Current Border Management Authority guidance expects citizens to enter and depart on a valid South African passport.
conditions: Applies to a valid South African ordinary passport; dual-citizenship rules and ordinary border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Ugandan ordinary passport holder: citizenship
policies.summary: The citizenship and immigration authority states that Uganda travel documents may only be held by Ugandan citizens.
conditions: Full valid ordinary Ugandan passport only; diplomatic, official, refugee and other special documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Costa Rican ordinary passport entry
policies.summary: The regulation reserves ordinary passports to Costa Ricans and requires nationals to demonstrate nationality on entry.
conditions: Full valid ordinary Costa Rican passport; nationality verification and ordinary border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Salvadoran ordinary passport holder: citizenship
policies.summary: The statutory passport definition makes a Salvadoran passport proof of Salvadoran nationality and identity abroad.
conditions: Full ordinary Salvadoran passport only; ordinary identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Honduran ordinary passport entry
policies.summary: The current Constitution guarantees entry, while the passport authority describes the document as proof of Honduran nationality and identity.
conditions: Full valid ordinary Honduran passport; normal migration control through an authorized port remains applicable.

policies.title: Panamanian electronic ordinary passport holder: citizenship
policies.summary: Law 493 confines electronic ordinary passports to Panamanians.
conditions: Electronic ordinary Panamanian passport only; normal border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Dominican ordinary passport holder: citizenship
policies.summary: The Foreign Ministry identifies the passport as issued to Dominican citizens and necessary for travel to the Dominican Republic.
conditions: Full ordinary Dominican passport only; provisional and emergency return documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bahamian ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: The Bahamas passport rules limit ordinary passports to Bahamian citizens.
conditions: Ordinary Bahamian national-passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Afghan ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Afghanistan's Foreign Ministry states that ordinary passports are issued to Afghan nationals.
conditions: Ordinary Afghan passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Brunei ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Brunei Immigration issues biometric ordinary passports to Brunei citizens.
conditions: Ordinary Brunei biometric passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Chinese ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: The PRC Passport Law makes the passport a nationality-and-identity document for PRC citizens entering and leaving China.
conditions: PRC ordinary passport only; SAR travel documents and other special document classes are separately classified.

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR passport-holder status
policies.summary: HKSAR passport eligibility requires Chinese citizenship and HKSAR permanent-resident status.
conditions: HKSAR passport only; BN(O), other British passports and non-permanent-resident documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Macao SAR passport-holder status
policies.summary: Macao SAR passport eligibility requires Chinese nationality and Macao permanent-resident status.
conditions: Macao SAR passport only; Portuguese passports, travel permits and non-permanent-resident documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Mongolian national-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Mongolia's current national-passport law issues the document at the request of a citizen and governs return home.
conditions: Mongolian national passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Myanmar ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Myanmar's Passport Law requires a Citizenship Scrutiny Card for an ordinary-passport application.
conditions: Ordinary Myanmar passport only; the official source endpoint is intermittently unavailable on raw replay.

policies.title: Pakistani ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Pakistan's passport authority issues ordinary passports to all Pakistani citizens.
conditions: Ordinary Pakistani passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Monegasque passport-holder citizenship
policies.summary: Monaco's official passport-management record verifies status for persons of Monegasque nationality.
conditions: Monegasque national passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Montenegro identifies its passport as proof of Montenegrin nationality and provides a return document to nationals who lose it abroad.
conditions: Montenegrin passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Omani ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Oman's current passport-replacement service expressly requires the person to be of Omani nationality.
conditions: Omani passport holder only; foreign resident cards and special travel documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Papua New Guinean ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Papua New Guinea's passport authority requires citizenship evidence for a PNG passport application.
conditions: PNG passport holder only; the official endpoint is Cloudflare-protected in raw curl replay.

policies.title: Samoan ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Samoa's passport policy states that ordinary passports are issued to all Samoan citizens.
conditions: Samoan ordinary passport holder only; lawful document, identity and border controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Solomon Islands ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: The Solomon Islands ordinary-passport process requires the applicant to declare continuing Solomon Islands citizenship.
conditions: Solomon Islands ordinary passport only; emergency certificates and other travel documents remain outside scope.
